newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Darling Park Trust to list early.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Darling Park Trust to list early.

text.p: Managers of the Darling Park Trust, Lend Lease Corp Ltd, said on Wednesday the trust would list on the Australian Stock Exchange on December 12.
The early listing was due to oversubscriptions to the public offer, Lend Lease said.
Its major asset is its interest in the Darling Park commercial property development at Darling Harbour in Sydney.

It said 130 million units were offered at A$2.50 per unit, partly paid to A$1.00 with the final instalment of A$1.50 per unit due on December 31, 1999, when the project reaches completion. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
